name: Agave
reasons: Both agave and honey only tolerated in tiny amounts
Often used in larger quantities, making it problematic

name: Kefir (Regular)
reasons: Fermentation reduces but doesn't eliminate lactose

name: Avocado
reasons: ¼ avocado or more is high FODMAP

name: Blackberries
reasons: Watch portions - fructose adds up beyond 30g

name: Dates
reasons: Fructose builds up in larger servings

name: Grapes
reasons: More than 10 grapes becomes high FODMAP

name: Raspberry
reasons: Fructose adds up at larger servings
Keep to ⅓ cup or less

name: Watermelon
reasons: Very small safe portion due to fructose + mannitol

name: Brioche (Artisan)
reasons: Lactose from dairy does NOT reduce with time
1 slice keeps both fructans + lactose tolerable
If lactose-tolerant, fructans are the only concern

name: Brioche (Commercial)
reasons: Often contains honey or high-fructose sweeteners

name: Sourdough (Commercial)
reasons: Fast-rise methods (1-2 hrs) skip fructan breakdown
Check label: yeast listed = fake sourdough

name: Sourdough (Rye)
reasons: Rye is very high in fructans + GOS
Even long fermentation can't reduce enough
Remains high FODMAP regardless of process

name: Sourdough (Traditional)
reasons: Bacteria consume FODMAPs before you eat
White wheat, wholemeal & spelt all safe

name: Chickpeas (Canned)
reasons: ¼ cup max for moderate tolerance

name: Lentils (Canned)
reasons: Safest lentil option - FODMAPs leach into brine

name: Peas (Green)
reasons: Easy to exceed in mixed dishes

name: Zucchini
reasons: Easy to exceed in pasta dishes
